ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 1:1 ratio between low-intensity (black/dark grey) central regions and high-intensity (white/creamy) lateral regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region and leading edges are dominated by low-intensity black pixels. Two distinct, high-contrast white circular focal spots are located symmetrically in the lower-central black region. Large contiguous white/yellowish patches occupy the outer third of both lobes, featuring secondary dark mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a deep vertical penetration into the fluke body, roughly 15-20% of the total visible height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration on the right lobe trailing edge with multiple jagged, irregular peaks. The left lobe exhibits a more moderate, lower-amplitude serration profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep from the median notch transitioning to a sharp upward curve at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, raised pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) are localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions are visible crossing the white regions of both lobes, particularly prominent on the lower portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular erosion and jagged tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe. Heavy barnacle colonization on distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Symmetrical pair of distinct white circular patches ('eye spots') located within the dark pigmentation of the central fluke area.
